verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a built-in Video Agent that takes delegated work. Users pick a style and "let the Video Agent handle the rest," review storyboards, send follow-up messages to iterate, and have it revise only the named scenes. The developer docs also describe an assistant that maps a described task to the endpoints that automate it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Video Agent, explicit documentation of the in-app (non-API) assistant experience, and evidence of delegation beyond video generation and endpoint mapping.
